description: Provision and deploy a new agent runtime. Queues the deployment and returns the created agent; poll get_agent until status is 'running'.

deploy_target.description: Deploy target, e.g. 'docker' or 'k8s' (default: control plane default)

execution_target_id.description: Specific execution target id (e.g. a registered Kubernetes cluster)

ram_mb.description: RAM in MB (self-hosted minimum 512; ignored in PaaS mode where the operator sets resources)

runtime_family.description: Runtime family (default: control plane's default, usually openclaw)

name: deploy_agent
title: Deploy a new agent
